item.title: Albania Is Not for Sale: Kushner's $4B Resort Triggers'Flamingo Revolution'
item.description:

item.title: Making Graphics Like it's 1993
item.description:
📝 Palette Rendering VGA Graphics Mode 13h on VGA hardware was the famous 320x200 256-color graphics mode that defined a generation of PC games. One byte per pixel, and that byte is an index into a palette which contains actual RGB values that would be rendered to screen. So how does one create graphics that work within these limits.
🔗 Read more: https://staniks.github.io/articles/catlantean-3d-blog-1/

item.title: WWDC 2026: Apple is Folding
item.description:
📝 On every iPhone Apple has ever shipped, that number is one. Apple announced that iOS apps will now support resizing in iPhone Mirroring on Mac, and for the first time, the mirrored window can be extended horizontally, stretching to a landscape aspect ratio that no current iPhone produces natively. That is not an experience Apple intends to repeat.
🔗 Read more: https://cupertinolens.com/2026/06/09/wwdc-2026-apple-is-folding/

item.title: GentleOS – Classic operating system with a lovely retro GUI
item.description:
📝 By design it's entirely monolithic, mostly configured at compile time, and only supports standard PC devices: VGA/SVGA, keyboard, PS/2 mouse, serial mouse, PC speaker. The only future plans are bugfixes, optimizations, and adding more apps. item.title: The iPhone's Last Stand
item.description:
📝 At the same time, the fact that Apple is behind the state of the art might not matter that much given Apple’s market and opportunity in that market. Moreover, the fact that Siri will have access to your iPhone gives it all of the same advantages that made me optimistic about Apple Intelligence in the first place. What this means is that Apple Intelligence is by-and-large focused on specific use cases where that knowledge is useful; that means the problem space that Apple Intelligence is trying to solve is constrained and grounded — both figuratively and literally — in areas where it is much less likely that the AI screws up.
🔗 Read more: https://stratechery.com/2026/the-iphones-last-stand/
